sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about things I did in the past using regular and irregular verbs like van, megy, jön, eszik, and iszik.
I can say what I bought, saw, or found using vettem/megvettem and láttam/láttad.
I can say who I met using találkozik + -val/-vel.
I can describe what I did with something afterward, using vele and verbs like hazavisz, elad, and eltesz.
I can connect several past-tense events into a short story using előbb, aztán, utána, később, and végül.
